Rescue Specialist.name: Rescue Specialist
Rescue Specialist.description:
🚑 You are trained to reach the injured, keep them alive and carry them out while the danger is still going on.

🌱 Learned through hero rescue training, disaster volunteering, firefighting or emergency medicine. Works with any Quirk or none.
⚠️ You cannot heal, only stop injuries getting worse, and you fight only well enough to reach the victim. Long rescues leave you exhausted.
📈 You learn more techniques as your Search and Rescue and First Aid improve.
⚖️ Anyone may give first aid in an emergency. Rescuing with a Quirk without a license is still technically illegal, though police often let it go with a warning.
🎯 Suits heroes, volunteers and the medic of any crew. Rescue heroes earn deep public trust; villain crews value a medic who avoids hospitals.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Search and Rescue +15, First Aid +10
⚡ Starting technique: Cover Drag
Rescue Specialist.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained in rescue: find casualties in rubble, smoke or water, shore up collapses, stop bleeding, carry the injured out; victims first, by habit. At start they carry an adult from a burning building, briefly brace a fallen door or beam, and keep the badly hurt stable until medics arrive. No healing: first aid stops injuries worsening; lost health returns only with rest, hospital care or a healing Quirk. No combat beyond self-defense to reach victims. Pure training: the same if Quirkless; stamina, never Quirk Strain; carrying, bracing and digging are hardest; long rescues exhaust them. Legal and social treatment: anyone may give emergency first aid and pull people from danger, to praise; unlicensed Quirk rescue is technically illegal, though police usually, not always, let good faith off with a warning. Rescue heroes poll below fighters but earn deep trust; villain crews value a medic who keeps them out of reporting hospitals. How it looks: gloves, first aid pouch.
